focus: Pause resume held input and stale callbacks

route_status.proven_scope: The unchanged probe_ui_system passed once on exact Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf with an isolated save profile at the frozen baseline. Its pause section sets main.game and phase, calls main.toggle_pause() directly, checks pause state/layer and large menu targets, then calls main.toggle_pause() again and checks unpause/layer restoration. Source review also traced live global-navigation and cancellation handlers.
route_status.route_gaps: The probe constructs this as a fixture: it sets Sky Lagoon root state directly and never presses the visible GlobalNavigationButton, the Resume button, or a gameplay target during the pause section. It does not send a held touch, release after resume, fire a delayed callback, or exercise activity teardown. The matrix's 'live' hint is not route evidence. No Mobile-rendered view, physical target phone, child session, or owner acceptance was observed.

code_constants.value: Pause/resume probe has no settling wait between direct pause and resume calls; runner used 22.63 seconds wall time.
code_constants.scope: The immediate calls prove state toggles and layer restoration only; the 22.63 seconds is test execution time, not gameplay duration or a pause-response measure.

code_constants.value: Pause menu Resume button rect is 580x140 canvas pixels; corner navigation target is 112x112 canvas pixels.
code_constants.scope: Probe asserts the Resume target is at least 300x140 and global navigation at least 112x112; these are source/canvas dimensions, not projected phone measurements.

timing.assumptions: No child-session or gameplay duration is estimated. Source waits and runner wall time do not represent a play session.

tactile.target_size: Global navigation is authored as a 112x112 canvas target and the dominant Resume control as 580x140; the probe checks minimums of 112x112 and 300x140 respectively (scripts/pause_menu.gd:25-30, 67-70; scripts/probe_ui_system.gd:502-511, 531). Native phone millimetres, visual separation, and screen readability were not measured.
tactile.press_response: Source connects GlobalNavigationButton.button_down to global_navigation_pressed and then NavigationController.press(); valid pause toggling cancels touches and presents the sheet (scripts/pause_menu.gd:25-30, 121-122, 165-194; scripts/navigation_controller.gd:60-85). The probe invokes main.toggle_pause() directly, so it does not measure touch-to-visible-frame response.
tactile.drag_hold_release: PauseMenu.toggle_pause() cancels all TouchUI state on pause; Melody and Slide Race have explicit held-source pause callbacks. No hold, drag, release, or post-resume input was sent in L37 (scripts/pause_menu.gd:165-206; scripts/games/melody.gd:869-886; scripts/games/slide_race.gd:742-762).
tactile.ownership: Main's pause wrapper cancels TouchUI state before delegating; the controller also cancels on its pause edge. Melody blocks a previously held source until release, and Slide Race moves held steering sources into a blocked set and clears active steering (scripts/main.gd:3769-3773; scripts/pause_menu.gd:165-182; scripts/games/melody.gd:869-886; scripts/games/slide_race.gd:742-762). These are source-level lifecycle protections, not routed-event proof.
tactile.cancellation: The general TouchUI route is cancelled on pause and cleared again on resume; shop and fairy shooting additionally wait for release of a keyboard confirm source (scripts/pause_menu.gd:171-172, 195-206). This probe does not show that any stale callback is harmless after resumption or activity exit.

play_appeal.agency: Hypothesis: a prominent Back to Play action plus optional picture-first collections may let a young player take a break and choose to return without treating pause as failure. L37 only checks control presence and scripted state toggles, so this is not observed child preference.
play_appeal.variety: The sheet offers Resume, Stickers, Critters, Stuffie, and a context-dependent neutral Back; L37 verifies these menu targets exist but does not open them through the UI or assess whether the choices feel distinct.
play_appeal.world_response: Pause source clears owned touch state and the tree pause state stops ordinary gameplay; no rendered character/world freeze, stale action, sound, or resume response was observed in this headless run.
play_appeal.replay: Not assessed. Probe reopens no activity and does not test a voluntary return after leaving the sheet.

play_sequence.input: Use an ordinary, visible route to enter a live activity on the approved phone; begin one activity action that accepts a held source, then keep that same finger down.
play_sequence.wait: Hold only until the activity visibly acknowledges the action; record actual elapsed time and frame count instead of assuming a duration.
play_sequence.grounding: scripts/pause_menu.gd:177-181; scripts/games/melody.gd:869-886; scripts/games/slide_race.gd:742-762. The probe does not execute this beat.

play_sequence.input: In a separate technical pass, use a second finger to press the visible upper-left 112x112 Back/Menu control while the first activity finger remains held.
play_sequence.wait: One button-down event; measure rendered frames from press to visible pause sheet on video.
play_sequence.grounding: scripts/pause_menu.gd:25-30, 121-122; scripts/navigation_controller.gd:60-85; scripts/pause_menu.gd:165-182. Two-finger phone behavior was not tested by L37.

play_sequence.input: Keep the original activity finger down and wait while the menu is open; do not press Resume yet.
play_sequence.wait: Wait exactly 2 seconds, then note whether any work, score, movement, or delayed action changes behind the sheet.
play_sequence.grounding: The tree is paused and TouchUI is cancelled by scripts/pause_menu.gd:165-194; stale callbacks and two-second behavior remain unverified.

play_sequence.input: Tap the dominant Back to Play button once, keep the original finger down for one more second, then lift it.
play_sequence.wait: One Resume tap; wait 1 second after resumption before lifting the old activity finger.
play_sequence.grounding: Resume is connected to toggle_pause at scripts/pause_menu.gd:67-70; post-resume clearing is at :195-206. L37 calls the toggle method directly instead of pressing the button.

play_sequence.input: After both fingers are lifted, wait without input, then make one fresh intentional action on the same target.
play_sequence.wait: Wait exactly 2 seconds idle; then one press/release, with video timing for acknowledgement and any unintended action during idle.
play_sequence.grounding: Tests DL-UI-05 and DL-MOT-05 against the cancellation/release-latch code at scripts/pause_menu.gd:171-206 and melody.gd:869-886 or slide_race.gd:742-762.

play_sequence.input: In a separate child discovery session, show the ordinary pause sheet without explaining its labels; allow the child to choose Resume or one pictured collection option, then observe whether they return to play or voluntarily stop.
play_sequence.wait: Allow 30 seconds for an unprompted choice; if the child acts, observe 60 seconds after returning, then stop when they choose to leave.
play_sequence.grounding: The source choices are defined at scripts/pause_menu.gd:67-97. These proposed bounds are observation instructions, not durations observed in L37; do not use a technical second finger in the child session.

observations.title: The pause sheet cancels touch state before gameplay is paused
evidence: scripts/pause_menu.gd:165-182 sets the pause edge, calls touch_ui.cancel_all_touches(), notifies Melody/Slide Race, then changes SceneTree.paused.
scripts/main.gd:3769-3773 also calls cancel_all_touches() before delegating to PauseMenu.toggle_pause().
observations.reproduction: Static source trace; L37 did not create a held pointer event or test a later callback.
observations.child_impact: If these cancellation paths work through the actual input route, a held action should not keep controlling the activity behind the pause sheet. A touch-route or downstream callback defect could still leave motion/action active.
observations.proposed_repair: No implementation change proposed from this source evidence. Keep lifecycle cancellation and verify the held-input route on the target device.
observations.acceptance_test: On the exact candidate phone, hold one activity action, open pause, wait 2 seconds, resume while the original finger is still down, lift, and observe 2 seconds idle. Confirm no delayed action, score, movement, or reward occurs; then verify one fresh intentional action still works.

observations.title: Melody and Slide Race preserve release latches across pause
evidence: scripts/games/melody.gd:869-886 blocks the active source on pause, resets press state, and retains a release latch; resume clears it only when no pause-release wait is pending.
scripts/games/slide_race.gd:742-762 moves active steer sources into a blocked set on pause, clears active steering, and retains the block until source release.
observations.reproduction: Source inspection only; probe_ui_system does not enter either game or send held-source input during pause.
observations.child_impact: The explicit release boundary is intended to prevent a held source from becoming a fresh note/steer action after the menu closes; device event ordering and actual feel remain unknown.
observations.proposed_repair: Preserve the release latch unless a routed test demonstrates a missed or duplicated input; do not infer a defect from the probe's narrower scope.
observations.acceptance_test: For Melody and Slide Race separately, hold one supported source, pause, resume without releasing it, then release and wait 2 seconds. Assert no note/steer/progress while blocked, then press once and confirm exactly one valid response. Include focus loss and re-entry in the broader phone matrix.

observations.title: The trusted UI probe validates menu structure and pause state but not pause input
evidence: audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L37/attempt_1/receipt.json: PASS; exact Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf; isolated profile; exit_code 0; no failure lines.
audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L37/attempt_1/probe.log:130-142 checks menu layer, Resume size, storybook shell, and restored normal overlay order.
scripts/probe_ui_system.gd:494-528 sets Sky Lagoon root fixture and directly calls main.toggle_pause(); :560-562 directly calls it again and checks unpause/layer restoration.
observations.reproduction: The assigned single run passed the named UI probe. The pause subsection uses direct method calls and contains no InputEventScreenTouch, held pointer, callback scheduling, or display capture.
observations.child_impact: The result supports pause-sheet structure and state toggling; it cannot show that the child can find or press the control, that held work remains cancelled, or that the sheet is visually legible on the phone.
observations.proposed_repair: Do not alter the existing probe to imply coverage. Add a separately scoped routed-input/device leg only if authorized study work can establish it without changing the existing assertion semantics.
observations.acceptance_test: Record an ordinary route on the intended phone: capture upper-left navigation press, visible sheet response in frames, held-action cancellation, Resume press, no stale action after lift/idle, and a successful fresh action; retain the child comprehension and preference observation separately.

observations.title: Resume visibly prioritizes returning to play while collections remain optional
evidence: scripts/pause_menu.gd:67-97 builds dominant 580x140 Back to Play, secondary Stickers/Critters/Stuffie tiles, and hidden-by-default neutral Back.
scripts/probe_ui_system.gd:531-548 checks the Resume and secondary targets plus neutral exit semantics; runtime probe.log:131-140 records the related menu assertions.
observations.reproduction: Source and existing UI assertions; no child selected a control in this review.
observations.child_impact: A large direct return choice may support interruption recovery. Text-heavy labels and choice competition still need non-reader and phone-size observation.
observations.proposed_repair: No code change proposed from the current evidence; test which control the child identifies and chooses without adult explanation.
observations.acceptance_test: At native phone aspect, present the menu after a real pause. Without naming buttons, ask no question and allow the child to act; record first touch, time to return, accidental neighboring choice, and whether the child voluntarily resumes play or chooses a book.

observations.title: Stale callback safety is not covered by this pause section
evidence: scripts/probe_ui_system.gd:528-562 toggles pause synchronously and checks the tree paused flag and layer values; it does not queue or fire a delayed callback across pause/resume.
scripts/pause_menu.gd:165-206 handles pause/resume state and source release guards; no callback-generation token or delayed callback assertion is exercised by L37.
observations.reproduction: Coverage observation from the existing probe; no stale callback defect is reproduced or alleged.
observations.child_impact: A callback that survives suspension could cause an unexpected action after the child believes play is paused or after they resume; this study supplies no evidence that such a callback currently fires.
observations.proposed_repair: Keep this as an acceptance gap, not a new defect. Exercise a real delayed action/temporary activity callback across pause, resume, and exit before considering code changes.
observations.acceptance_test: In one focused lifecycle test, schedule the activity's existing delayed action, pause before its deadline, wait past the deadline, resume, and then exit/re-enter once. Assert no gameplay effect or saved progress occurs while suspended or after teardown and that the next active action still works.

strengths.claim: The pause/resume and menu-layout section passes at the exact baseline, including paused state, pause-layer order, dominant Resume control, and restored unpaused layer.
strengths.evidence: audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L37/attempt_1/receipt.json and probe.log:130-142; direct method fixture at scripts/probe_ui_system.gd:528-562. Internal probe evidence only.

strengths.claim: Pause code explicitly clears general touch ownership and gives Melody/Slide Race held sources a pause/release boundary.
strengths.evidence: scripts/pause_menu.gd:165-206; scripts/games/melody.gd:869-886; scripts/games/slide_race.gd:742-762. Static source evidence; no routed touch result.

strengths.claim: Resume is the primary pause-sheet action and voluntary activity exit is labelled neutrally as Back.
strengths.evidence: scripts/pause_menu.gd:67-97, 138-140; scripts/probe_ui_system.gd:531-548. Presence/size assertions do not establish child comprehension.

acceptance_gaps: L37 is INTERNAL_PROBE: Sky Lagoon root fields are assigned directly and pause/resume are method calls, not routed screen touches.
No held finger, drag, release-after-resume, stale delayed callback, activity exit, focus-loss, or save/re-entry scenario was executed.
No Mobile-rendered capture, native phone touch geometry, response-frame latency, frame pacing, or audio audibility evidence.
No observed child comprehension, voluntary pause/resume choice, comfort, session duration, or appeal evidence; play appeal is a hypothesis only.
MA-TOUCH-001 remains FIXED_PENDING_VERIFICATION pending the exact target-phone held travel/drag/multitouch/focus-loss/pause/re-entry matrix; this L37 internal probe does not change its lifecycle.
